answer_1.quote: Dialogue summarization, a recently popular subfield of text summarization, has more challenging factual issues involved ...

answer_2.quote: We select four commonly used factuality metrics: FactCC, DAE, QuestEval, and BARTScore ...

answer_3.quote: BARTScore is also used to assess factuality ...

answer_4.quote: We recruited college students as annotators ... For each summary, the annotators will determine whether it is factually correct first ... Finally, if the summary contains any factual errors, they will write a corrected summary.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed a detailed annotation guide that asked them to label error categories, assess factual correctness, and ensure the corrected summary is fluent, coherent and non‑redundant.
